Type:        DATA_READER
Name:        UniversalDataReader
Category:    readers
Description: Reads data from delimited or fixed length files and sends data records to first connected output port. If any error occurs, the report is sent to the second port if "Data policy" is set to "Controlled". This component is alias for FlatFileReader.
Usage:       Use to read delimited, fixed-length, or mixed flat files into records, including local/remote files, archives, input-port sources, and irregular text parsing scenarios. It is the UniversalDataReader alias of FlatFileReader, so it fits standard flat-file ingestion when you need file-reading flexibility rather than a specialized reader.

Input Ports:
  [0] input (optional)
Output Ports:
  [0] output (required)
  [1] logs (optional)

Properties:
  Always required:
    fileURL

  fileURL: [file] (REQUIRED)  Specifies the path or URL of the input file to read data from. This is the primary attribute that determines which file will be processed by the component.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to decode the input file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect the encoding automatically.
  dataPolicy: [enum]  (default: Strict)  Controls how the component handles data parsing errors and malformed records during processing.
    values: strict, controlled, lenient
  skipFirstLine: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, skips the first line of the input file, commonly used to ignore header rows in CSV files.
  trim: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, removes leading and trailing whitespace from string field values during parsing.
  quotedStrings: [bool]  Enables parsing of quoted string values in delimited files, allowing strings to contain delimiter characters.
  quoteCharacter: [readerQuoteChar]  Specifies the character used to quote string values in delimited files when quoted strings are enabled.
  skipLeadingBlanks: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, ignores leading whitespace characters before field values during parsing.
  skipTrailingBlanks: [bool]  (default: false (true for fixlen metadata))  When enabled, ignores trailing whitespace characters after field values during parsing.
  skipRows: [int]  (default: 0)  Specifies the number of records to skip from the beginning of the file before starting to process data.
  numRecords: [int]  Limits the maximum number of records to read from the input file. If not specified, all records are processed.
  skipSourceRows: [int]  When processing multiple input sources, specifies the number of records to skip at the beginning of each source file.
  numSourceRecords: [int]  When processing multiple input sources, limits the maximum number of records to read from each source file.
  missingColumnHandling: [enum]  (default: Treat as error)  Defines how the component handles missing columns in the input data compared to the expected metadata structure.
    values: treat_as_error, fill_with_null
  maxErrorCount: [int]  (default: (unlimited))  Sets the maximum number of parsing errors allowed before the component stops processing. Unlimited if not specified.
  treatMultipleDelimitersAsOne: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, treats consecutive delimiter characters as a single delimiter, useful for handling inconsistent spacing.
  incrementalFile: [file] (required when incrementalKey is set)  Specifies a file used to store incremental processing state, enabling the component to resume from where it left off.
  incrementalKey: [string] (required when incrementalFile is set)  Defines the key field used for incremental processing to track the last processed record position.
  verbose: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, provides detailed logging information about the data reading process for debugging purposes.
  parser: [enum]  (default: Auto)  Specifies the parser implementation to use for reading the input data, with automatic selection as the default.
    values: org.jetel.data.parser.SimpleDataParser, org.jetel.data.parser.DataParser, org.jetel.data.parser.CharByteDataParser, org.jetel.data.parser.FixLenByteDataParser

To configure it, call component_get_guide("DATA_READER") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
